name: ai-growth-studio
description: Practical growth workflows for home service businesses, starting with a lead-to-job revenue leak audit.

interface.shortDescription: Find gaps from leads to jobs
interface.longDescription: Audit lead handling and job conversion for home service businesses. Work through inquiries, response, follow-up, booking, and completed jobs. Receive a company-branded Markdown report and styled HTML companion, with evidence labels, conditional opportunity estimates, and a practical implementation blueprint. The current version contains one revenue audit skill; additional skills are planned. No live CRM, phone, advertising, or scheduling connections are included.
defaultPrompt: Audit where my home service business loses leads before they become jobs.
